messages:
deploy-bot: AUTOTRIGGER HOLD: p95 latency + error-rate threshold breached for service=runtime-eu-dedicated. reason=latency_noise; suggested_action=hold_and_notify; evidence=metrics://canary/1758312400..1758312460
aj: seeing it too, p95 jumped from 120ms -> 680ms in the last 2 mins :grimacing:
sanjay: logs - increased KV cache misses on nodes eu-ded-3/4. suspect kvcache eviction after recent kernel flag flip. fetching logs now.
emily: do we want to let deploy-bot auto-revert or take manual control? product-facing customers on dedicated pools, want careful comms.
molly: prefer manual. Auto-revert can cascade to traffic storms if fallback model not warmed. ops-lead, do you want manual rollback to 2.5.9 or pin current and scale?
ops-lead: authorize manual rollback for critical slices. target rollback: service runtime -> v2.5.9 for eu-dedicated pool only. keep hosted/other regions on current.
sanjay: confirm scope: eu-dedicated pool only, rolling revert to v2.5.9; I'll start drain for nodes 3/4 first.
molly: drafting customer-facing blurb and internal release note. quick copy: "We detected latency regression for EU dedicated customers; rolling back runtime to v2.5.9 for that pool to restore SLOs. No data loss expected. ETA 15-30m."
emily: good. also notify sales + CS for any impacted committed customers. @aj can you post a short status update to #customer-success?
aj: on it.
ops-lead: sanjay, when you have drain started, post the small playbook cmd in this thread. we'll run rollback in gated steps.
sanjay: drain cmd: ```
# drain node
kubectl cordon node/eu-ded-3 && kubectl drain node/eu-ded-3 --ignore-daemonsets --timeout=5m
# then deploy rollback for slice
deployctl rollback --service runtime --version v2.5.9 --scope eu-dedicated --strategy rolling --max-unavailable 1
```
ops-lead: perfect. execute after drain completes. keep alerts muted for noise and escalate only on new errors.
molly: release note updated, internal comms queued. pinging sales/CS.
aj: posted update in #customer-success and DM'd the top 3 enterprise contacts.
sanjay: drain started on eu-ded-3 (30% traffic shifted)
ops-lead: initiating rollback when drain hits 80% island.
deploy-bot: NOTE: autopilot revert suppressed by human hold flag (reason=manual_intervene). to re-enable run `/deploybot set-autorevert on` after validation.
molly: copy. will validate post-rollback perf for 15m before unmuting alerts.
emily: thanks team. once stable, we'll create a short postmortem and decide whether to revert the kernel flag.
ops-lead: timeline: rollback start ~ 1758312510, expected finish ~1758312570. will update thread.
sanjay: rollback started 1758312512. monitoring p95 and kvcache hitrate.
aj: ack.
ops-lead: rollback finished on eu-dedicated at 1758312568. p95 back to 110ms. closing hold.
deploy-bot: HOLD_CLOSED: manual rollback complete. autopilot remains disabled until owners re-enable. metrics://canary shows regression cleared.
emily: nice work. follow-up: schedule kernel-flag canary with smaller blast radius before re-enabling auto-revert.
molly: I'll own the follow-up ticket and postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
